column1: # One row per test source declared in repro_tests.nim, sorted by source.
# This is a SOURCE-TEXT scan, not the authoritative per-binary catalog
# count: it sums every when/else branch and cannot expand wrapper
# templates or loops that register a case per element. It is pinned
# anyway because it is the only case-count surface that can be measured
# — and regenerated — without a fully built tree, which is what makes it
# a gate everyone can actually keep green.
# Regenerate after adding or removing test cases:
# Review the diff. A row that DECREASES or DISAPPEARS is a test leaving
# the suite; that is the event this baseline exists to make visible.
